rules.quote: Maintain fully independent bridge implementations for Mapbox and Maplibre
rules.rule: Maintain fully independent bridge implementations for Mapbox and Maplibre; do not force them into a shared bridge abstraction.

rules.quote: only putting pure utility functions and intersection types in the shared package
rules.rule: Only put pure utility functions and intersection types in the shared package.

rules.quote: Shared package**: Only put truly shared code — `deep-equal.ts`, `style-utils.ts`, basic type definitions
rules.rule: Only put truly shared code (such as deep-equal.ts, style-utils.ts, and basic type definitions) in the shared package.

rules.quote: it must be manually `import`ed at the application entry point
rules.rule: Import maplibre-gl's CSS file (maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css) explicitly at the application entry point; it does not load automatically.

rules.quote: When writing docs or examples in the future, remind users they must import CSS themselves.
rules.rule: When writing docs or examples for maplibre-gl, remind users they must import the CSS themselves.

rules.quote: Don't use headless screenshots to diagnose map rendering issues.
rules.rule: Do not use headless Chrome screenshots to diagnose map rendering issues.

rules.quote: Instead check: (1) JS console errors (2) DOM structure (whether canvas exists) (3) whether CSS is loaded.
rules.rule: When diagnosing map rendering issues, check JS console errors, DOM structure (whether the canvas exists), and whether the CSS is loaded instead of relying on headless screenshots.

rules.quote: If visual verification is needed, have the user check in a real browser.
rules.rule: When visual verification of a map is needed, have the user check it in a real browser rather than headless Chrome.

rules.quote: If you only want to close via the X button, explicitly set `:closeOnClick="false"`.
rules.rule: To make a Popup close only via its X button, explicitly set closeOnClick to false.

rules.quote: Documentation should explain this default behavior.
rules.rule: When writing Popup documentation, explain that closeOnClick defaults to true.

rules.quote: Remove these three keys from the Map component's `INIT_OPTION_KEYS`
rules.rule: When upgrading to maplibre-gl v5, remove `antialias`, `preserveDrawingBuffer`, and `failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat` from the Map component's `INIT_OPTION_KEYS` array.

rules.quote: add `canvasContextAttributes`
rules.rule: When upgrading to maplibre-gl v5, add `canvasContextAttributes` to the Map component's `INIT_OPTION_KEYS` array.

rules.quote: Remove optional chaining (`map.getProjection?.()`) and `@ts-ignore` comments for `map.setProjection?.()` in the bridge class.
rules.rule: When upgrading to maplibre-gl v5, remove the optional chaining from `map.getProjection?.()` calls in the bridge class.

rules.quote: Remove optional chaining (`map.getProjection?.()`) and `@ts-ignore` comments for `map.setProjection?.()` in the bridge class.
rules.rule: When upgrading to maplibre-gl v5, remove the `@ts-ignore` comments on `map.setProjection?.()` calls in the bridge class.

rules.quote: Consider the interaction between marker click and map click when designing.
rules.rule: When designing features with markers on a maplibre-gl map, consider how marker clicks interact with the map's click event.

rules.quote: the watch getter must explicitly access inner fields (e.g. `vs?.longitude`)
rules.rule: When a Map component's watch tracks a reactive object passed as a prop, the watch getter must explicitly access each inner field of that object (e.g. vs?.longitude) so Vue tracks nested changes.

rules.quote: Remove `flush: 'sync'` and use the default `pre`.
rules.rule: Do not use flush: 'sync' in the Map component's watch; use the default flush ('pre') instead.

rules.quote: Add a `width > 0 && height > 0` guard.
rules.rule: When viewState width or height is used to trigger resize sync, add a guard that only proceeds when width > 0 and height > 0.

rules.quote: destructure every field of viewState in the getter
rules.rule: Whenever the Map component watches prop changes to sync to the bridge, destructure every field of viewState in the watch getter.

rules.quote: don't use `flush: 'sync'`
rules.rule: Whenever the Map component watches prop changes to sync to the bridge, do not use flush: 'sync'.

rules.quote: Use `h()` not JSX
rules.rule: Do not use JSX syntax in Vue component render functions in .ts files; use the `h()` function instead.

rules.quote: Vue component render functions should uniformly use the `h()` function
rules.rule: Write all Vue component render functions using the `h()` function.

rules.quote: All Vue component render sections use `h('div', {attr: val}, children)` form
rules.rule: Write Vue component render sections in the `h(tag, attrs, children)` form.

rules.quote: don't access emit internals
rules.rule: Do not access emit internals (such as `emit.$.args`) in Vue 3 components.

rules.quote: Maintain a `CALLBACK_EVENTS: (keyof MapCallbacks)[]` static array and iterate over it to build callbacks
rules.rule: Maintain a `CALLBACK_EVENTS: (keyof MapCallbacks)[]` static array and iterate over it to build callbacks.

rules.quote: always use predefined static arrays to build callbacks
rules.rule: In emit-bridging components like map.ts, always build callbacks from predefined static arrays.

rules.quote: Use `emit('onError', ...)` directly for error handling
rules.rule: Use `emit('onError', ...)` directly for error handling instead of reading handlers from props.

rules.quote: don't try to read from props
rules.rule: When needing to emit events, do not try to read event handlers from props.

rules.quote: All optional string props should have `?? defaultValue` when passed as arguments
rules.rule: When passing an optional string prop as an argument, apply a `?? defaultValue` fallback.

rules.quote: Maintain an `INIT_OPTION_KEYS` constant array, extracting corresponding values from attrs to pass to the bridge class
rules.rule: Maintain an `INIT_OPTION_KEYS` constant array and extract the corresponding MapOptions init values from attrs to pass to the bridge class.

rules.quote: When encountering build failures, look at ESM/CJS errors first to fix syntax, then DTS errors to fix types
rules.rule: When diagnosing build failures, fix ESM/CJS syntax errors first, then fix DTS type errors.

rules.quote: instead use the `useMapContext` composable (internally uses `watch` + `immediate: true`) to wait for context availability before initializing
rules.rule: In overlay components that depend on Map context (Marker/Popup/Source/Layer/Control), do not read context directly in onMounted; instead use the useMapContext composable to wait for context availability before initializing.

rules.quote: `popup.addTo(map.getMap())` is wrapped in `setTimeout(0)`
rules.rule: In the Popup component, wrap popup.addTo(map.getMap()) in setTimeout(0) so the pending map click is processed before the closeOnClick handler is registered.

rules.quote: The recommended pattern is `closeOnClick: false` + marker toggle behavior (clicking the same marker closes)
rules.rule: When implementing a Popup that opens on marker click, set closeOnClick to false and implement toggle behavior where clicking the same marker closes the popup.

rules.quote: update the detailed design (changed files, key decisions, implementation details) into the current task document under `.claude/tasks/`
rules.rule: After exploring the codebase, update the detailed design (changed files, key decisions, implementation details) into the current task document under .claude/tasks/ before executing.

rules.quote: Implement according to the design in the task document
rules.rule: Implement the task according to the design recorded in the task document.

rules.quote: After task completion, append a `## Summary` section at the end of the task document
rules.rule: After completing a task, append a `## Summary` section at the end of the task document.

rules.quote: recording actually modified files, newly created files, deleted files, and key design decisions
rules.rule: In the Summary section, record the actually modified files, newly created files, deleted files, and key design decisions.

rules.quote: Update the design into the task document at the start of each task
rules.rule: At the start of each task, update the design into the task document.

rules.quote: append a summary to the same document when complete
rules.rule: When a task is complete, append a summary to the same task document.

rules.quote: All plans/tasks use the project-local `.claude/` directory, not the global Claude path.
rules.rule: Store all plans and tasks in the project-local .claude/ directory, never in the global Claude path.

rules.quote: When creating a new plan, also update the `PLAN.md` index and memory.
rules.rule: When creating a new plan, also update the PLAN.md index and memory.

rules.quote: Specific phase task lists, acceptance criteria and other details go in the corresponding task files; the plan file only serves as an index.
rules.rule: Put specific phase task lists, acceptance criteria and other details in the corresponding task files, not in the plan file, which serves only as an index.

rules.quote: **Plan files**: `{sequence}-{name}.md`
rules.rule: Name plan files as {sequence}-{name}.md (e.g. 00-init.md).

rules.quote: **Task files**: `{planName}-phase-{number}-{name}.md`
rules.rule: Name task files as {planName}-phase-{number}-{name}.md.

rules.quote: Use `scripts/publish.sh` — builds all, publishes in order, skips already-published versions.
rules.rule: To publish packages to npm, use `scripts/publish.sh` rather than publishing packages individually.

rules.quote: pnpm publish: `workspace:*` auto-resolved to real versions (don't use `npm publish` directly)
rules.rule: Do not use `npm publish` directly; publish packages with `pnpm publish` so that `workspace:*` dependencies are resolved to real versions.

rules.quote: Scoped packages (`@map-gl/*`) need `--access public`
rules.rule: When publishing scoped packages (`@map-gl/*`), pass `--access public`.

rules.quote: `--no-git-checks` required (pnpm rejects unclean working trees)
rules.rule: When running `pnpm publish`, pass `--no-git-checks`.

rules.quote: npm warns about `--git-checks` being unknown CLI config — harmless, ignore it
rules.rule: Ignore npm warnings about `--git-checks` being unknown CLI config; do not treat them as errors.

rules.quote: Bump `version` in its `package.json`
rules.rule: Before publishing a package, bump its `version` in its `package.json`.

rules.quote: Phase 0 only configures Prettier; ESLint is left for later phases as needed
rules.rule: In Phase 0, configure only Prettier and do not set up ESLint; defer ESLint to later phases as needed.

rules.quote: Playground aliases must use absolute paths
rules.rule: Playground aliases must use absolute paths, not relative paths.

rules.quote: aliases must use `resolve(__dirname, '..')` to build absolute paths
rules.rule: In vite.config.ts, build alias paths with `resolve(__dirname, '..')`.

rules.quote: point to `src/index.ts` files rather than directories
rules.rule: Point vite.config.ts aliases to specific entry files such as `src/index.ts`, not to directories.

rules.quote: always use `resolve(__dirname, '..')` to build paths
rules.rule: When modifying vite.config.ts aliases, always use `resolve(__dirname, '..')` to build paths.
